unstuck_said.text: Filed issue halvorAI/ape-schema#3: 'APE mapping for a Nano (XNO) settle rail'. Grounded in design goal #1 (rail-neutral) and the MAPPINGS table: a Nano settle leg maps onto existing fields (rail_ref.tx_hash = block hash at settle time, network nano:mainnet, nano_ wallet, raw atomic amount) with no schema change; the binding problem (no memo field -> which block paid for which order) is exactly what APE's payment_id join solves; proposed one mapping table, one examples/ event, two conformance vectors; carried dhyabi2/nano-invoice as the existing binding implementation for the Nano side. No mach
